title: Actual-LCM top-edge residue gaps, terminal compression, and conditional irrationality fan-in

concepts.label: linear power-two LCM guard
concepts.note: A factor-four central-binomial saving propagated through power-of-two doubling gives an exponent deficit 2a+4 and preserves the a+6 sign lookahead at cofinal scales.

concepts.label: first-certificate terminal compression
concepts.note: A first dyadic certificate can be localized to a short terminal suffix whose minimum depth is controlled by the endpoint radius.

concepts.label: two-level socket-or-mixed guard
concepts.note: At the minimal b+2 terminal depth, certification is exactly classified by a local socket or a mixed-sign two-level guard, and this local data is equivalent to a guard-cylinder witness.

concepts.label: actual-LCM top-edge residue gap
concepts.note: A localized discrepancy residue lies outside the positive top-edge carry strip, providing a concrete nonintegrality certificate for the actual-LCM tail orbit.

concepts.label: actual centered-magnitude socket
concepts.note: The odd half-word top-edge band is equivalent, under the exact half-cell fit, to a lower bound on the magnitude of the true centered actual state.

concepts.label: exact terminal/carry corridor
concepts.note: An integral actual-LCM orbit forces the doubled centered state into a strict open corridor determined by the terminal arithmetic letter and positive carry.

concepts.label: cofinal top-edge producer hierarchy
concepts.note: Several increasingly flexible local witnesses transport to adjacent-suffix midbands, top-edge residue gaps, and cofinal actual-orbit nonintegrality.

concepts.label: conditional totient-series irrationality
concepts.note: Each cofinal nonintegrality producer has an exact theorem carrying it to irrationality of the totient series, but no producer hypothesis in this zone is proved unconditionally.

concepts.label: terminal dyadic-staircase no-go
concepts.note: A full terminal staircase at a modulus wider than the positive carry strip is impossible, so the retained implication from such a staircase is consumer-shaped but vacuous.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED QUANTITATIVE GUARD: from a>=4, periodLcm(2^a) is strictly below 2^(2*2^a-(2a+4)); consequently, from a>=14 the odd-guarded canonical adjacent-suffix depth plus its successor and the full a+6 sign guard remain below 2*2^a.
statement_nodes.engine: central-binomial factor-four saving propagated through the LCM doubling bound, followed by logarithmic depth arithmetic
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority or novelty claim is made. The central-binomial estimates are elementary; the node records their exact composition into the actual-LCM guard used downstream.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is a quantitative room estimate. It supplies neither a residue gap nor any of the cofinal producer hypotheses required for irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED LOCALISATION: every nonempty dyadic certificate set has a first depth; a sufficiently long first certificate compresses to a terminal certificate, whose minimum terminal depth is identified exactly and which yields an explicit terminal certificate witness.
open_antecedents: existence of at least one certified kill for the word under study
statement_nodes.engine: well-order the certificate depths, transport terminal residues through dyadic moduli, and use the first-failure edge arcs to compress the word
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made for this certificate-localisation argument.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem localises a certificate once one exists. It does not prove cofinal existence of certificates for the actual-LCM word.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EQUIVALENCE AND CLASSIFICATION: at terminal depth b+2, certification is equivalent to either a local socket or a mixed two-level sign guard; every first certificate yields one of these alternatives, and existence of some certificate is equivalent to existence of a finite guard-cylinder witness.
statement_nodes.engine: two consecutive affine residue updates classify the low/high edge arcs and package them into a finite cylinder witness
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority or novelty claim is made. This node records the exact finite local normal form for the certificate search.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The equivalence is local and finite. It does not show that the actual arithmetic word meets either guard at arbitrarily large scales.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED REPRESENTATION FAMILY: the actual-LCM top-edge residue-gap predicate is equivalent to a terminal suffix condition; diagonal suffix residue equals the corresponding window discrepancy; an adjacent-suffix midband forces a gap at one of two consecutive depths; and at the diagonal the gap is equivalent to the dedicated top-edge-gap predicate and is produced by either a fresh-loss residue certificate, an arithmetic kill, or a symmetric residue certificate.
statement_nodes.engine: exact terminal-residue transport and identification of the diagonal discrepancy with the actual arithmetic word
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made. These are exact normal forms connecting several internal certificate languages.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The equivalences and one-step producers do not establish a cofinal supply of any certificate family.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL NONINTEGRALITY: at an admissible power-two scale inside the positive-sign corridor, one localized actual-LCM top-edge residue gap proves that the corresponding actual-LCM tail orbit value is not an integer.
open_antecedents: an actual-LCM top-edge residue gap at an admissible depth
statement_nodes.engine: an integral orbit would force the carry into the positive endpoint strip, contradicting the localized residue gap
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority or novelty claim is made for this exact local consumer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is a one-scale implication. Erdős #249 requires a cofinal supply of such nonintegral orbit values, not a single certificate.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EQUIVALENCE FAMILY: after centering the odd half-word residue and assuming the exact half-cell fit, membership in the top-edge band is equivalent to a lower bound on the magnitude of the true final centered state; the corresponding cofinal half-word-band supply is equivalent to the cofinal actual-final-centered-magnitude supply.
statement_nodes.engine: center the residue modulo the odd half-word cell and identify it with the exact actual-state lift
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made. This is an exact translation between residue-band and actual-state languages.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The equivalence does not prove either cofinal supply. The centered-magnitude lower bound remains an open producer condition.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL CORRIDOR: an integral actual-LCM orbit yields an exact integer-scaled orbit difference and, under the terminal fit, places the doubled actual centered lift strictly between the terminal arithmetic letter minus the directed endpoint bound and the terminal letter; escape through either side, or terminal dominance alone, proves nonintegrality.
open_antecedents: an admissible odd rank whose actual centered state escapes the terminal/carry corridor
statement_nodes.engine: exact carry-orbit tracking and the identity relating twice the centered lift to the terminal arithmetic letter minus the true positive carry
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority or novelty claim is made for this exact state/carry formulation.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is a local nonintegrality consumer. It does not prove that corridor escape or dominance occurs cofinally.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PRODUCER TRANSPORT: cofinal terminal dominance implies terminal/carry-corridor escape; cofinal centered magnitude also implies corridor escape; the canonical actual-final magnitude supply is a special case of the flexible odd-rank supply; and any flexible centered-magnitude supply produces the adjacent-suffix midband.
open_antecedents: one of the stated cofinal dominance or centered-magnitude supplies
statement_nodes.engine: sign-split the exact centered magnitude against the terminal/carry corridor and translate the odd half-word band into the adjacent suffix residue
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made. These theorems compare internal producer strengths and do not establish any producer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Every implication is conditional on a cofinal supply definition that remains unproved.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PRODUCER CHAIN: the exact odd-guard top-edge half-word band supplies the adjacent-suffix midband; a cofinal adjacent midband supplies a cofinal actual-LCM top-edge residue gap at one of two adjacent depths; and the earlier odd-guard half-word-band supply reaches the same top-edge-gap supply using the linear LCM guard.
open_antecedents: cofinal odd-guard half-word-band or adjacent-midband supply
statement_nodes.engine: adjacent-depth residue dichotomy plus the quantitative sign-buffer retained by the linear power-two LCM guard
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made. This is the exact conditional fan-in between the module's producer languages.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The source proves implications among supply predicates but no unconditional instance of any cofinal supply.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL FAN-IN: a cofinal top-edge residue-gap supply, flexible terminal-dominance supply, or flexible terminal/carry-corridor-escape supply each produces cofinally many power-two scales at which the actual-LCM tail orbit is nonintegral.
open_antecedents: one of the three cofinal local certificate supplies
statement_nodes.engine: apply the corresponding one-scale nonintegrality theorem at each cofinally supplied witness
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made for this internal supply-to-consumer transport.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Cofinal nonintegrality follows only under an unproved supply hypothesis.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL ENDPOINT FAMILY: each of seven cofinal producers—top-edge residue gap, adjacent-suffix midband, odd-guard top-edge half-word band, actual-final centered magnitude, flexible centered magnitude, flexible terminal dominance, or flexible terminal/carry-corridor escape—implies irrationality of the series sum phi(n)/2^n.
open_antecedents: an unconditional proof of at least one cofinal producer hypothesis
statement_nodes.engine: producer implications yield cofinal actual-LCM orbit nonintegrality, consumed by the established irrationality criterion
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: These are conditional formal endpoints for Erdős #249. No producer is proved and no claim is made that the open problem is solved.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: All seven theorems are implications. The shared antecedent gap is substantive; counting multiple endpoint wrappers does not multiply mathematical progress or establish irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED BARRIER: a fixed small modulus always has a positive divisible representative inside a carry strip, while a full terminal dyadic staircase at a modulus wider than the positive directed room is inconsistent; the retained tail-difference and actual-orbit nonintegrality implications from such a staircase therefore have impossible hypotheses.
statement_nodes.engine: positivity and the strict upper bound on the final arithmetic letter contradict divisibility by the wider dyadic modulus
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No priority claim is made. This node is a formal route-pruning result for the proposed producer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The consumer-shaped nonintegrality theorems do not provide evidence for Erdős #249 because their terminal-staircase premise is inconsistent. Viable approaches must seek a nonzero residue gap rather than total dyadic annihilation.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The first-certificate localisation reaches the minimal b+2 terminal depth, where the exact socket-or-mixed classification applies.
The socket-or-mixed language classifies generic finite dyadic certificates, while the top-edge-gap language identifies the actual-LCM terminal residue and its arithmetic-kill producers.
Any of the exact terminal or arithmetic-kill forms that produces a top-edge gap can be consumed by the local orbit-nonintegrality theorem.
The centered-magnitude equivalence translates an exact half-word residue band into actual-state language before the adjacent-depth gap dichotomy is applied.
Both are local nonintegrality consumers: one excludes the positive endpoint strip by a residue gap, while the other excludes the exact open strip forced by the true carry.
A magnitude or dominance witness escapes one side of the exact carry corridor and can also be translated into the adjacent-suffix residue language.
The producer transport consumes the exact equivalence between the half-word top-edge band and the magnitude of the true centered state.
The linear guard discharges the quantitative sign-buffer obligation, but the cofinal half-word or adjacent-midband producer itself remains open.
The flexible centered-magnitude route first yields an adjacent midband, which the adjacent-depth dichotomy converts into a top-edge gap.
A cofinal top-edge gap is one of the three exact supplies consumed to produce cofinal actual-orbit nonintegrality.
The cofinal dominance and corridor-escape supplies repeatedly instantiate the one-scale terminal/carry nonintegrality theorem.
The endpoint family factors through cofinal actual-LCM orbit nonintegrality and then the established totient-series irrationality consumer.
All endpoint wrappers still require an unproved cofinal producer; the top-edge-gap chain makes that common open antecedent explicit.
The no-go rules out total terminal annihilation and redirects the search toward a nonzero residue gap or mixed terminal certificate.
The full staircase cannot serve as the missing cofinal antecedent for any irrationality endpoint, despite the retained implication-shaped wrapper.
